_about: Code-only game rules of Race Into Space (upstream HEAD e1fbccc) transcribed into data. Every top-level key carries provenance in a sibling _source entry or inline 'source' fields, as 'src/game/file.cpp:LINE' relative to reference/raceintospace/. See docs/specs/code-derived-rules.md for the plain-English rules.
prestige_rows_source: src/game/endgame.cpp:50 PF[29][40]; src/game/museum.cpp:56 tame[29][40]; enum PrestigeValues src/game/data.h:1105-1135 (Prestige_Duration_A = -1 is deliberately out of table; Prestige_LunarMoonwalk = 40 is a hero flag only)

prestige_award.subsequent_rule: Add[2] is only paid while the running mission total is < 3 (prest.cpp:424)
prestige_award.chained_credit: A first/second on a row also flags lower rows in the same chain as done without paying points: MannedOrbital->OrbitalSatellite, LunarFlyby->MannedOrbital, LunarProbeLanding->LunarFlyby, LunarPass->LunarProbeLanding, LunarOrbit->LunarPass, LunarLanding->LunarOrbit, Duration C->B, D->C, E->D, F->E, TwoPerson->OnePerson, ThreePerson->TwoPerson, Minishuttle->ThreePerson, FourPerson->Minishuttle
prestige_award.failure_rule: The single highest manned milestone attempted and failed pays Add[3] once (NegGoal, prest.cpp:531,609)

milestones.skip_rule: For the highest milestone in the mission's PCat list, every lower-numbered milestone with Mile==0 costs 3 safety on every hardware step (MilestonePenalty). Milestones the mission does not satisfy still count.

duration_levels.mission_days_field: mission.json Days = minimum duration level for the plan (0 = unmanned; 1-6 = A-F). For Dur==1 plans the player picks any level >= Days up to 6 (future.cpp:884 MaxDur=6, :1043).

budget.season_end: Budget += Prestige earned this season (each player), then Budget capped at 180; Prestige reset to 0
budget.year_end: at the end of Season 1 (fall) Cash += Budget; if Cash > 999 then Cash = 900

newscast_adjustment.band_rule: j = k where range[k] < Budget <= range[k+1]; j = 5 if Budget > 160
newscast_adjustment.ntable_layout: 180 ints = 3 blocks of 60; each block = 6 bands x 10 picks. Only block 0 (indices 0-59) is used for both players; the +60 / +120 blocks are a TODO for difficulty

budget.half_price_sale_event: TurnOnly == 3 halves InitCost and UnitCost for the season (min 1)

effects_game_level.effect: Mission step die: easy uses MisRandom() (uniform 1-65, else Gaussian mean 57 sd sqrt(1000) clipped to 66-100, biased against high rolls); medium/hard use uniform 1-100 (AI 1-98)
Crew death: easy halves the hardware Safety; otherwise Safety reset to Base. MaxRD reset to MSF (original MaxRD) in both cases
R&D team cap: hard allows 5 teams always; easy/medium cap teams at min(MaxRD - Safety, 5)

Presidential review: a season with prestige <= -10 raises the review index by 1 + level (operator-precedence bug: expression parses as (1+(plr==0)) ? Lev1 : Lev2, so it adds Lev1 for USA, Lev2 for USSR, never the +1)

Score multiplier: own level 1 => 1x prestige; level 2 => 2x (+1/3 if opponent level 1, 5/3 if opponent level 3); level 3 => 3x (+2/3 vs level 1, +1/3 vs level 2). Lunar landing bonus by year: L1 50 (<=67) / 25 (<=69); L2 75/50/25 (<=73); L3 150/75/50
AI opponent gets +25 MB cash injections when buying big rockets, and extra R&D passes, only if the human is NOT on easy (Level_Check)
Presidential review can only fire the player (PresRev >= 16) when playing an AI and the human is not on easy
EASYMODE flag is set when one side is easy and the other hard, but nothing reads it

effects_astronaut_level.effect: Recruit stats shown: always Capsule+Endurance; Docking also if level < 2; LM+EVA also if level < 1 (needs feat_show_recruit_stats)
Crew compatibility display: level 0 shows per-crewmate compatible/incompatible; level 1 shows one 'CREW RELATIONSHIP' colour; level 2 shows nothing
Successful-mission mood: code adds two branches; USA on easy gets +20+15=35, otherwise +15+15=30; USSR on easy +15+20=35, otherwise 30

rnd.cost: RDCost MB per team, paid once per season per program
rnd.roll: each team rolls 1d(6 + RD_Mods_For_Turn); sum is added to Safety, capped at MaxRD
rnd.rd_mods: event cards: 15-18 => +1 this turn; 3,61,62 => -1 this turn and RD_Mods_For_Year=-1; 19 => -2 this turn; 41 => -2 this turn and -2 for the year; 42,43 => RDCost+1 on the most advanced program. Only positive year mods are copied into the next turn (start.cpp:729-733)
rnd.max_rd_growth: after any mission with a successful step on that hardware, MaxRD += 1 (cheat_addMaxS default 1), capped at MaxSafety - 2

tech_transfer_on_program_purchase.note: Buying a new program sets its starting Safety from related programs' Safety. Formula shape per unit: Safety = base + min(cap, (related.Safety - threshold) / divisor); some combos set a fixed value when two related programs are >= 75

purchase.delay: a program with Delay > 0 (set only by event cards, 2 seasons) cannot be bought

mission_roll.safety_for_step: MisSaf of the step's hardware (Safety + SMods + Damage at launch, minus requirement/rush/LM penalties) + crew skill (asf), capped at 99
mission_roll.joint_duration: average of both capsules' MisSaf when both crews are in space
mission_roll.save_card: a program holding a SaveCard (event card) cancels one failure
mission_roll.failure_type_roll: rnum 1-10000 for manned steps matched against fails.json percentage (first row with percentage > rnum); unmanned steps roll -(1..5) and match percentage == rnum

safety_after_mission.success: +1 Safety per hardware item with at least one successful step (not docking module, not photo recon), capped at MaxSafety
safety_after_mission.failure: no generic reduction; failure codes 24/26 cut Safety by rand(0..9); crew death halves (easy) or resets to Base; booster Safety follows the primary rocket if it was reset to Base
safety_after_mission.temporary: MisSaf penalties, SMods, Damage and DCost are cleared after the mission

mission_code_tokens.+1 / +2: switch following steps to launch vehicle 1 or 2 of a joint mission (+n => pad + n - 1)
mission_code_tokens.~nX: interplanetary coast: repeat step letter X n times
mission_code_tokens.^ / &: switch to second / first pad (unused alternates of +)
mission_code_tokens.!: end of main path; everything after is an alternate branch (PastBANG=1)
mission_code_tokens.I: always resets to the primary pad
mission_code_tokens.d: alternate-path marker: previous step's success/failure goto = Alt[step] (0 => 100 = end)

mission_step_letters._note: loc = letter - 'A' (lowercase letters continue after Z: a=26 .. g=32); failure table key FName = 'F0' + loc (F1xx/F2xx/F3xx are special-case variants chosen in mc2.cpp:593-670). class = hardware rolled against.

B.name: ORBITAL INS. BURN
B.class: Kicker if fitted, else Capsule, else LM, else Probe/DM; after step 11 Capsule

C.name: HARDWARE POWER-ON
C.class: Kicker-C, else LM if present, else Probe/DM
C.prestige: OrbitalSatellite (0) only for the orbital probe (ID P0)

Q.name: LEM ACTIVITIES
Q.class: Kicker-C, else LM, else Capsule, else Probe/DM

S.name: LUNAR LANDING
S.prestige: LunarProbeLanding (7) for the lunar probe (ID P2)

W.name: PLANETARY ACTIVITIES
W.prestige: LunarFlyby (1) / Mercury 2 / Venus 3 / Mars 4 / Jupiter 5 / Saturn 6 by mission

g.name: EARTH ORBITAL INS. BURN
g.note: loc becomes 29 when mission.Lun is set

missSteps_json.meaning: Future Missions diagram drawing commands (letters A-K with numeric parameters, terminated by Z). Pure graphics; no rules.

fields.MissionStep: F-code matched against the step's FName (4 chars)
fields.percentage: manned: upper bound of the 0-10000 band (rows scanned in file order, first with percentage > rnum wins); unmanned: -1..-5 exact match
fields.val: handler parameter (safety cut %, injury/survival %, flag bits, pad repair MB)
fields.xtra: second handler parameter (death %, pad repair MB)
fields.fail: two-digit animation suffix appended to the step name to pick the fseq.json failure clip; NOT an outcome

failure_codes.unmanned_rule: any failure on a fully unmanned mission ends the mission (StepInfo 1003); code 12 also destroys the pad for 20 MB

3.effect: kill all crew on this launch, mission ends

4.effect: branch to alternate step (fgoto); end if none; prestige on this step invalidated

7.effect: flagged permanent safety cut; code only sets StepInfo and continues (no Safety change found)

9.effect: recheck the same step with new dice

12.effect: MisSaf -= val, launch pad destroyed (repair cost = xtra MB), mission ends

13.effect: kill all crew, pad destroyed (repair = val, or xtra if val==0), mission ends

15.effect: MisSaf -= rand(1..20); player may scrub (abort to alternate) or continue

16.effect: per crew member: val% chance of harm; of those, xtra% die else injured; then branch if anyone alive

17.effect: per crew member: xtra% retire; then each survives with val% else dies; branch if alive

18.effect: set mission flag bits val; if already set, branch to alternate (prestige invalidated)

19.effect: set flag bits val and recheck the step

22.effect: EVA specialist survives with val% else dies; branch to alternate

23.effect: per crew member val% retire; branch to alternate

24.effect: hardware recovered: Safety -= rand(0..9) permanently, mission ends

26.effect: Safety -= rand(0..9) permanently and branch to alternate

30.effect: duration failure: Duration reset to 1 (A), stop duration loop, continue

31.effect: kill the LM crew (all crew on direct ascent / Soyuz LL); branch via death goto

33.effect: kill crews on both capsules (docking), mission ends

40.effect: minor docking failure: continue unless a later step needs docking (TLI 9, LEM thrust 26, joint duration 28)

stepinfo_classes.4xxx: whole crew killed (4197/4198/4199 = first/second/both launches in joint missions)

astronauts._source: src/game/ast1.cpp, ast2.cpp, ast3.cpp, start.cpp AstroTurn, astros.cpp; per-rule sources inline below

recruitment.recruit_losses: 60% chance to lose 1 point from Endurance or Capsule (50/50); then 3 points removed at random from LM/EVA/Docking (may go negative; raised to 0 after basic training)

basic_training.gain_per_season: one random skill below 4 gains +1 (70%) or +2 (30%)
basic_training.washout: each season 5% chance of an incident: of those 75% (minus 10% per Endurance point) injured 2 seasons, else retired

advanced_training.gain: +1 to the focus skill at season 2 and at completion (+2 total)

mood.crew_conflict: -3 per incompatible crewmate (-2 in minishuttle/four-man programs)

compatibility.rule: ast likes peer if peer.Compat in [ast.Compat - CL, ast.Compat + CR] on a ring of 10; not symmetric

retirement.unhappy_rule: Mood < 20 and active: USA retires in 2 seasons (delay 2), USSR retires immediately; reason 13
retirement.mustering_out: every even season once Active >= 8: 10% chance; USA delay 3, USSR delay 2; reason 1-6
retirement.scared_after_death: bit 1 of MissionCatastrophicFailureOnTurn: USA 20% / USSR 10% chance, capped at 40% of active roster; but bit 1 is never set in the RIS code (only |=4 and =2 exist) so this is dead
retirement.injury_resolution: InjuryDelay counts down each season; mission injury = 3 seasons (reason 'Injured for a year')
retirement.death: Status DEAD, reason 8; counted in tMen

astronauts.hero: crew of a first on MannedSpaceMission, WomanInSpace, MannedOrbital, MannedLunarPass, MannedLunarLanding; the EVA specialist for Spacewalk / Lunar EVA firsts

calendar.win_condition: first successful Manned Lunar Landing (Prestige row 22 Place set) ends the game after that launch sequence
calendar.annual_review: computed at the start of every spring (season 0) except 1957 from the last two seasons' prestige; review index 1-16; 16 = fired
calendar.review_delta: val = sum of the two seasons (or max/2+min if signs differ): val<0 and idx<4 => +1; 2..10 => -1; 11..20 => -1 (idx<4) else -2; >=21 => -1 (idx<4) else -3; -9..0 => +1; <=-10 => +1 (+level, see bug); then +1 if your index is above the opponent's; clamp 1..16
calendar.interplanetary_resolution: Mars/Jupiter/Saturn flybys resolve Event seasons later (2/4/7) with a yearly brandom(100) > Saf failure test
calendar.patch_index: records.cpp:62 Pict[56] is a museum image index table, not a rule

launch_pads.repair: pay the stored cost in the Administration building
